I changed `_get_client_hello` in `mitmproxy/addons/next_layer.py`, but I haven't confirmed that it fixes your stall. I didn't run or add any tests.

I never found the stall itself. `NextLayer._ignore_connection` matches ignored hosts partly by the SNI in the client's ClientHello. Previously, when the QUIC ClientHello was incomplete (the parser returned `None`), `_get_client_hello` treated that as "no ClientHello".
